scope: Available cumulative counters for this development conversation through the checkpoint. Later/unrecorded work and separate service credits are excluded. Cached input is part of input; reasoning output is part of output. These are token counts, not a bill. The provider counter history contains 3 downward revisions; this report uses the latest reported cumulative checkpoint rather than summing cumulative snapshots.

developmentTime.method: Elapsed = first task_started timestamp to final task_complete timestamp. Active = sum of duration_ms for unique completed turn IDs, as reported by the session runtime; not a gap-threshold estimate.
developmentTime.scope: All completed work in this game conversation: design/research and learning discussion, art generation, implementation, testing, builds, documentation, trailers and uploads. Includes tool execution and waits within active turns. Excludes gaps between turns, the current timing audit, and unrecorded/offline human work. This is assistant runtime, not human labor or pure CPU/GPU/model inference time.
developmentTime.clockCaveat: The runtime reports durations separately from start/end timestamps. The difference is recorded above; its cause is not identified in the log. Use reported duration_ms without inventing an allocation.
